# Networking Experts

> IT services company in Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, India. We install and
> support CCTV cameras, computer networks, WiFi, biometric access control,
> video door phones and smart home automation for homes and businesses.

Customers book a service request online at
https://services.networkingexperts.in/ and receive a ticket number
(format NE-YYMMDD-XXXX) to track progress live. A technician is assigned
and visits on site. Billing is GST-compliant with online payment links.

## Services

- CCTV Camera Installation: HD/IP cameras, DVR/NVR & storage setup, cabling,
  mobile + desktop remote viewing, demo & 30-day support.
- Networking & LAN Setup: structured cabling, LAN/WAN design, router, switch
  & firewall configuration, IP planning, labelling & documentation.
- WiFi / Access Point Setup: coverage heat-map survey, access point mounting
  & configuration, seamless roaming, speed & coverage testing.
- Biometric & Access Control: fingerprint/RFID devices, user enrolment,
  door lock integration, attendance & report setup.
- Video Door Phone / Intercom: outdoor + indoor units, wiring & power,
  mobile call forwarding.
- Smart Home Automation: smart lights, sensors & hubs, app and voice
  control, training & support.
- Repairs & support: internet down, slow connection, WiFi issues, CCTV
  camera offline, hardware repair, software issues.
